docs.description: Concert Grande , hosted by Joe Patrych and Bruce Posner, aired on WFUV radio in New York City from July 1977 until July 1993. It featured keyboard performers, some of whom were also composers. This show aired on June 28, 1982 and contains an interview with Percy Grainger expert, John Bird. Mr. Bird gave a lecture entitled, "Grainger as pianist". John Bird - lecture The show includes musical examples performed by Grainger, unless otherwise noted: - Schumann's Sonata #2 in G Minor, Scherzo movement - Grainger's arrangement of a sea shanty, "One More Day, My John" - Bach-Liszt - Fugue in G Minor from the Fantasia and Fugue in G minor BWV 542 - excerpt from a player piano etude of Conlon Nancarrow - Grainger's arrangement of Shepherd's Hey - Grainger's arrangement for the "Pianola" player piano of Shepherd's Hey - Liszt - Polonaise #2 in E Major - Grieg - To Spring, Lyric Piece, Op. 43 #6 - Grainger's Paraphrase on Tchaikovsky's Flower Waltz from The Nutcracker - Grainger's arrangement of Brahm's Crade Song - Grainger's arrangement of the Mock Morris dances - Grainger's arrangement of Molly on the Shore - Grainger's arrangement of Country Gardens
